mentions.name: TTRPG site
mentions.description: A tabletop RPG web platform built on the creator's own IP, designed to make game sessions smoother with an intuitive UI that minimizes tedious tasks. Features include enemy HP bars that can show an actual percentage or cracked bars indicating damage ranges, shareable personal notes plus a community notes section, and automatic notifications driven by passive perception (e.g., alerting players to hidden doors). It is in early alpha testing with friends and aims to eliminate common GM pain points so more groups form.
mentions.problem: TTRPG sessions involve tedious tasks and general GM pain points that discourage groups from forming.
mentions.audience: Game masters and tabletop RPG groups
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a ttrpg site for the last year with my own IP. The intent is to create an experience that makes an intuitive UI that minimizes tedious tasks.
